title: Unauthenticated Basket IDOR on E-Commerce Platform
summary: Identified unauthenticated cross-user basket read vulnerability via GraphQL IDOR. Basket UUIDs assigned pre-authentication allowed any actor to read another user's basket contents with zero credentials. Confirmed valid by program; closed as duplicate.

timeline.summary: Identified GraphQL endpoints, confirmed introspection enabled, retrieved full schema.
Systematically tested high-priority mutations and queries for authorization failures.
Confirmed unauthenticated cross-user basket read. Basket IDs confirmed assigned pre-authentication.
Tested checkout mutation and attempted richer field queries. Impact ceiling established.
Finding submitted to bug bounty program.
Finding assessed as P4 and marked duplicate of 2024 report on out-of-scope target.

confidentiality.summary: Shopping intent data (SKUs, quantities, prices) exposed across all user sessions including guests. No PII or payment data accessible.

integrity.summary: Cross-user basket merge observed when authenticated user submits another user's basket UUID.

availability.summary: Basket state interference between sessions could disrupt active shopping.

privacy.summary: Shopping behaviour and product interest data exposed without consent.

regulatory.summary: Potential privacy consideration given behavioural data exposure.

lessons.summary: Check program disclosed reports and duplicate history before deep-diving on a finding.
Test the same vector across all in-scope targets before submitting in multi-target programs.
Establish the impact ceiling before submission rather than after.
Always test ID-based queries from a zero-auth baseline before adding session context.
IDORs on low-sensitivity data without PII will trend toward P4 regardless of exploit chain elegance.

seo.description: Case study: GraphQL basket IDOR allowing unauthenticated read of any user's shopping basket. Confirmed valid by bug bounty program, closed as duplicate.
